AzureAd._AllowedTenants_note: Empty = accept any Microsoft account: both Entra (work/school) organizations and personal Microsoft accounts (Outlook/Hotmail), validated by issuer shape. Populate with tenant GUID(s) to restrict.

_AzureAd_note: ClientSecret is supplied at runtime from Key Vault / App Service settings (AzureAd__ClientSecret) — never commit it.

Duel._TimeLimitSeconds_note: Per-model execution watchdog. 900 s on purpose: it has to cover WebGPU shader JIT on a browser model's first run and a cold Ollama load (a 17 GB model can take minutes before its first token). This is the value the execution service actually reads — until 2026-09-03 it shipped 300 while the code hardcoded 900, so the knob did nothing.

AzureAiFoundry._RemoteTimeoutSeconds_note: Override HttpClient.Timeout for the Foundry typed client. Phi-4 Mini cold-start exceeds the default 35 s and the previous attempts timed out before first token.

Limits._note: Guards on starting paid inference (POST /api/duels, POST /api/tournaments). DuelStartsPerMinute is a fixed window per signed-in user. DailySpendCapUsd is compared with the sum of today's (UTC) ApiCostUsd; once reached, duels with a Remote model and all tournaments get a 429 until midnight UTC. 0 switches either off. The judge's own calls are not counted.

AiJudge._note: When no human picks a winner within DelaySeconds of a duel finishing, this model decides and ELO moves. Verdicts it records are stored with VerdictSource=Ai so they stay distinguishable from human ones. Set Enabled=false to restore human-only verdicts. DelaySeconds is 10 below: short on purpose, so a duel resolves while you are still looking at it. At this width the judge decides nearly every duel — the human path is the Arena's vote buttons during the countdown. Widen it if you want reading time.
AiJudge._TextOnlyDeployment_note: Cheaper judge used when VisionEnabled is off (source-only judging does not need a vision-capable model). Leave empty to always use Deployment. A good pairing is gpt-5.4-mini for vision (required for image input) and gpt-4.1-nano for text-only — same verdict quality at ~1/8 the cost per duel.
AiJudge._TiebreakDeployment_note: When the two opposite-order judge calls disagree, both orders are asked again on this deployment at medium reasoning effort; they still have to agree or the duel is a Tie. Only splits pay for it. Must accept image input when VisionEnabled is on. Empty turns the tie-break off.
AiJudge._CrossCheckDeployment_note: A model from another family reads the second ordering (right page first), so a verdict must survive a swapped order AND a different judge. Must accept images when VisionEnabled is on. Without Gemini:ApiKey both orderings fall back to the primary judge.
AiJudge._EscalationDeployment_note: First re-ask of a split: both orderings on this one deployment at floor effort. Only a split that survives it reaches TiebreakDeployment. Empty skips straight to the tie-break.
AiJudge._RubricEnabled_note: Write each prompt's checkable requirements once (cached a day) and judge every reading against that one list. Off: each call derives its own.

Ollama._BaseUrl_note: Ollama's default context window is 4096 tokens TOTAL, which a 4096-token page cannot fit beside its prompt. SCRIPTS/setup.ps1 sets OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=8192; the /v1 route cannot set num_ctx per request.

Gemini._note: Optional second remote provider over Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Any model whose ApiEndpointRef starts with gemini- is sent here instead of Foundry — duels, the availability probe, and the judge if AiJudge:Deployment names one. Supply Gemini:ApiKey from Key Vault or a Gemini__ApiKey env var, never this file; with no key, the Gemini seed entries are skipped.
